notes.title: “Trainee Death Simulator”is now available for you to experience！
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is Bone Nail.

The full version of“Trainee Death Simulator”is now available for you to experience. The story of the game is centered around the Death Tower, and the special existence of the “Death” in our worldview.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176421/83662064734dbd9d1afe5796901f0d7d139bfb6a.jpg[/img]
It's a game of choice. You play as a Trainee Death on the lowest level of the Death Tower, but as you grow in seniority, you will gradually rise up the ranks. On your way up, you encounter various random events that affect the four attributes of Faith, Energy, Strength, and Evilness based on your choices. Reaching the limit of any one of these values - whether it's the upward limit or the downward limit - triggers a different Ending. Still more Endings are brought about by the game's event NPCs, including historical events, investment events, betting events, exploration events, and other more entertaining sets of events. A small grassroots employee can also become an indispensable presence, or a traitor to the Death Tower with your choices.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176421/be97165c00e220ab0c7e6a7accbfa00f5a2d468a.jpg[/img]
At the same time, this is also a dress-up game, the game debut a total of 16 sets of dress-up prepared. The Trainee Death travel the earth, not only to perform the duties of the Death, but also occasionally have to play a variety of human characters to complete the task. Cute schoolgirl JK, home dress, OL dress, imp dress, alchemist dress and so on are all available.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176421/ef80ac0d36f0e671fa60d1ad409e28f7bfa4e427.gif[/img]
After the release, we will continue to adjust and optimize the game based on your feedback, including but not limited to the stability of the game on different models of computers, the optimization of foreign language versions, and further refinement of some of the art resources.

If you encounter any bugs, please feel free to connect us and join the official Discord:   https://discord.com/channels/1073072214166999040/1165855576601923625

notes.title: Demo Hotfix V0.11
notes.content:
The following issues have been fixed:

1. Fix the issue unable to select the "Give Up" option during the debt-doubling event.
2. Fix the issue no notification displayed when unlocking outfits.
3. Fix the issue when wearing the outfit [Day of Humanity] and entering the second playthrough, the initial attributes are reduced to negative values, resulting in immediate death.
4. Fix the issue infinite loops occurring in special events such as the Hoshino's Shop and Lake Bathing.
5. Fix the issue starting the second playthrough immediately after reaching an ending does not complete the tasks.
6. Fix the issue certain in-game sound effects cannot be adjusted through the Settings.

notes.title: The Demo of "Trainee Death Simulator" is now available！
notes.content:
Offer for the Trainee Death:
Welcome to the Death Tower, where you'll embark on a journey of infinite possibilities as a Trainee Death. Change history, slay monsters, or simply be a slacker... No matter which path you choose, there are wonderful (?) endings and pretty outfits waiting for you!

Please note that the game is still in development and you may encounter issues such as save file confusion (very low probability), launch errors (low probability), mission text and image mismatches (this might not be a bug, pay attention to what mushrooms you've eaten), and other problems. We'll continue to optimize it and we're looking forward to hearing your suggestions!

Join our official Discord channel <https://discord.com/channels/1073072214166999040/1073072214984892417> where you'll meet fellow Death enthusiasts.
